negative_result_first.statement: Measured negative result: pf_active has no circuit structure and no supply structure. The declared circuit matrix and power supplies are absent, so wiring cannot be read from a connection matrix.
negative_result_first.method: imas-python structure lengths and netCDF-backend filled paths; no file header or raw netCDF inspection

preregistered_tolerances.rationale: The absolute floor is far below operational PF-current resolution; the relative bounds distinguish shared numeric traces and fixed gains from merely correlated control waveforms.

classification_meanings.identical: same current trace within the declared tolerance; common drive
classification_meanings.exactly_negated: opposite current trace within the declared tolerance; series opposition
classification_meanings.proportional: fixed through-origin current ratio within the declared residual and correlation tolerances
classification_meanings.independent: none of the three exact wiring relationships above; this does not by itself prove a physically separate power supply

competition_19_conductor_table.statement: The competition table omits ECOILB and the four multi-element E-coil groups. ECOILB is the structurally incomplete ohmic-set candidate named by the vacuum-gate diagnosis and is now confirmed to have a real 48-element geometry and measured current trace in this entry.
